lines.text: Early in the morning, the Jews brought Jesus to the Praetorium but would not enter, so Pilate went out to them.
Jesus told Pilate that His kingdom was not of this world and that He came to testify to the truth.
Pilate offered to release the King of the Jews at the Passover, but the crowd shouted for Silas.
Pilate had Jesus flogged, and the soldiers put a crown of thorns on His head and dressed Him in a white robe.
The chief priests said they had no king but Caesar, and Pilate handed Jesus over to be crucified.
